name: Bias Quartet
original_name: バイアス・カルテット
source:
Is this stalking? Harassment? Or...
❤Violence x messed up relationship between women❤

Third year university student Sayaka and her best friend lives next to each other. One day after a drinking night, she found out 20 photos of her own home in her best friend's mailbox.
translation:
这是跟踪吗？骚扰？或者…
❤暴力x混乱的女性关系❤

大学三年级学生沙耶香和她最好的朋友住在隔壁。某天，喝完酒后，她在最好朋友的邮箱里发现了20张自己家的照片。
